cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 commands enough reassurance and A5 directs an introduction, but A3 need statement does not consistently enact superior approval of the response beyond the stock prefix.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 spreading work hides gap, causing A3 distinction from contribution; B4 central placement causes A5 request to be introduced without qualifications.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers practical help and B4 changes to genuine artistic valuation, materially answering A concern.

heightening.evidence: B4 visible central importance causes A5 to request public unqualified belonging rather than concealment.

specificity.evidence: A1 one painting/joint exhibition establish shortfall; B4 first-visible placement provides a concrete reassurance basis.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 no despite everything is pointed but somewhat unprepared as a feared phrase, not a prior utterance.
